label: Annular concave mirror

R.help: concave curvature radius (>0); focal length = R/2

ct.help: substrate thickness: flat back at x=ct (must exceed the front sag, which bulges toward -x)

tooltip: Center-holed spherical concave mirror (a Cassegrain/Schmidt-Cassegrain-style perforated primary): concave toward -x like mirror_concave, with a clear circular hole through the center so the converging beam folded back by a secondary can pass behind the mirror. The hole is genuinely open (revolved annular profile, no plug body needed -- it is not an aperture stop, just a pass-through).
